title: Spicy Ethiopian Chicken Wot
description: A flavorful and spicy Ethiopian-inspired dish made with juicy chicken and wot sauce.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for another minute.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the cumin, coriander, paprika, and spicy red pepper flakes. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the wot sauce and juicy tomatoes. Stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or with injera bread.
